1.explanation:
• DataTable/DataTable.mdx – shows the “with filtering” usage where the bug is observed and the live example link in the issue.  
• DataTable/state/ – contains the stateful filter wrapper implementation that wires up the Search icon button into the DataTable header.  
• DataTable/stories/dynamic-content/ – the Storybook story source for the filtering example, useful for reproducing it locally.  
• Search/Search.mdx – documents the Search component’s markup, classes, and hover styles that control the icon input container.  
• SearchFilterButton/SearchFilterButton.mdx – defines the standalone icon‐only filter button styling that DataTable uses in selection mode.  
• IconButton/IconButton.mdx – covers the base IconButton API and hover/focus styling patterns that underlie the search icon’s wrapper and its alignment rules.
1.bug_scenario: On the DataTable “with filtering” example, when you hover over the standalone search‐icon button in the table’s header (the selection variant), the icon’s viewport or background square shifts slightly and the magnifying‐glass graphic looks vertically and horizontally misaligned inside its hover state box.
